body.name: full-class elbow handle
body.construction: Apply \(\mathsf{FrontierHandle}\) to the full class \(\mathcal G_{2}^{\mathrm{rat}}(n)\) in two stages.  For the upper stage, use the cubic graph-ideal presentation and effective lexicographic elimination to obtain \(D_2(n)\leq U_2(n)\).  For the sharp lower stage, first require every proposed family to satisfy the parameter-dimension screen that the number of missing bidirected pairs is at least \(|D|\); then certify that \(\phi_G\) is generically birational, compute \(\operatorname{Cl}_d(G)\) over every coordinate of \(\theta_G\), and require \(\operatorname{HTCcert}(G)=\operatorname{ICcert}(G)=\operatorname{ACcert}(G)=0\).  Use the exact \(K_6\) closure as the finite calibration.  The family \(W_{\ell}^{(2)}\) is retained only as the proved overparameterized counterexample.
